## File: facebookresearch_metamotivo/metamotivo/wrappers/humenvbench.py

Prompts

```
['create a BaseHumEnvBenchWrapper to run policy act inference on observations and context vectors', 'create a RewardWrapper to perform reward-based context inference using sampled dataset trajectories', 'create a GoalWrapper to infer context embeddings from a target goal pose', 'create a TrackingWrapper to infer context embeddings from next observation states', 'run the relabel function to compute rewards in parallel using thread or process pools']
```

Usage

```
{'create_BaseHumEnvBenchWrapper_act': 'create a BaseHumEnvBenchWrapper to run policy act inference on observations and context vectors', 'create_RewardWrapper_reward_inference': 'create a RewardWrapper to perform reward-based context inference using sampled dataset trajectories', 'create_GoalWrapper_goal_inference': 'create a GoalWrapper to infer context embeddings from a target goal pose', 'create_TrackingWrapper_tracking_inference': 'create a TrackingWrapper to infer context embeddings from next observation states', 'run_relabel_parallel_rewards': 'run the relabel function to compute rewards in parallel using thread or process pools'}
```
